entry.title: New: Resolution 281 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR A MULTI-YEAR LEASE FOR ONE LANDFILL BULLDOZER FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement at an approximate monthly cost of $21,667 to replace equipment that has reached its end of life.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 281-23 & FC-80 - 10/18/23
